notes: Every tracked path carries exactly one subsystem, one owner lane, and one feature tag; no path is unclassified.

Coverage tier "named" means a lane report contains the path literally (or as a unique path suffix with a line reference). "scope-specific" means only a directory wildcard of depth >= 2 covers it. "scope-broad" means only a root-level wildcard (e.g. docs/**, backend/**) covers it. "absent" means no report names or scopes it.
Files whose feature_kind is "doc" are documentation/evidence surfaces, not product features; they are still indexed and owned.
